cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll stay through this hard conversation. Someday I need you equally open with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Not points. A place where both of us can be unsteady.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know if I can.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say that honestly. It's a first payment.

mechanism: A calculates and corrects equivalence of emotional risk as a professional investment that B must repay.
confusable: Simple reciprocal kindness differs from explicitly treating vulnerability as a debt with comparable exposure.
comparison: A public admission to B's mother requires equivalent audience risk; a supportive conversation demands future reciprocal openness.
seedUse: Use the audience comparison and first-payment idea, giving the vague second seed a specific immediate situation.
